title: Two-word match ✅
description: Finds both starting positions where the two words appear as a direct concatenation. 🔎

title: No valid substring 🚫
description: Returns an empty list when no exact concatenation of all words is possible. 📭

title: Multiple overlapping matches 🔁
description: Detects several valid starting indices in a string with repeated word patterns. 🌐

title: Repeated-word sequence 💥
description: Handles repeated words properly when the same word appears multiple times in the list. 🔣

title: Single word match 🎯
description: Checks a simple case with one word to ensure the matching logic handles minimal input. 🧪

title: Exact full string match 🧠
description: Uses the entire string as a perfect concatenation of all words. ✅

title: Noisy string with hidden match 🔦
description: Finds a hidden valid substring inside a larger string with other characters around it. 🌟

title: Edge-case short string ⚠️
description: Handles a string that is too short to contain the full concatenation. 🛡️

title: Different order match 🔄
description: Verifies that words can be matched in any permutation order. 🎲

title: Single-letter repeat 🔡
description: Finds all valid starting points when words are single repeated letters. 🧩

title: Partial overlap no match ⛔
description: Ensures partial overlaps are rejected when the full word set is missing. 🚫

title: Identical words full match 🔁
description: Handles repeated identical words that require exact repeated segments. 🧠

title: Multiple valid positions 🧭
description: Finds every valid starting index when multiple concatenated permutations appear. 🌟

title: Repeated pattern match 🔄
description: Detects repeated exact-pattern concatenations in the string. ✅
